cues.163: Outdoor Room: a porch, terrace or courtyard with a floor, shelter, edge and a reason to stay.
cues.180: Window Place: a comfortable place to sit at a window, with light, a view and a sense of enclosure.
cues.104: Site Repair: place the building and its services to avoid damage and repair already disturbed ground.
cues.105: South Facing Outdoors: put the main outdoor places on the sunny side and shelter them from wind.
cues.106: Positive Outdoor Space: shape the outdoor space with the buildings so it has a clear form, not leftover space.
cues.155: Old Age Cottage: a small, accessible dwelling close to community support.
cues.171: Tree Places: preserve special trees and make places around them for sitting and gathering.
